content: {"reasoning": "The CO-197 denial is for missing prior authorization at time of service. This payer does not offer retroactive authorization or peer-to-peer review, so those paths are closed. Resubmitting or appealing again won't cure a missing auth requirement. Since the auth was never obtained and the payer offers no recovery mechanism, this is a non-collectible administrative denial that cannot be billed to the patient (provider's failure to obtain auth); it should be written off.", "action": "write_off"}
